Moving

Moving services

A team of professional movers, an equipped truck, fuel and mileage included — on weekends, when you are available.

Get a quote 514-424-7936

The service in detail

Groupe Gama offers moving services on weekends only, designed for individuals and small businesses who want a clear price and a careful crew. The truck arrives fully equipped: moving blankets for furniture, floor runners to protect your floors, dollies and straps. Fuel, mileage and full insurance are included in the quoted price.

What’s included

  • Weekends only: Saturday and Sunday
  • Equipped trucks (blankets, straps, dollies, floor runners)
  • Fuel (diesel) and mileage included
  • Full insurance during transport
  • Protective covers for all furniture and appliances
  • Furniture disassembly and reassembly on request

How it works

  1. Describe your home

    Number of rooms, floors at both addresses, elevator access, heavy items (piano, fridge, safe) and packing needs.

  2. Get your quote

    We send you a price and a time slot for the Saturday or Sunday you choose.

  3. Moving day

    The crew protects your floors, wraps the furniture, loads, transports and sets everything up in your new place.

FAQ

FAQ — moving services

Why weekends only?

From Monday to Friday our trucks and crews are dedicated to commercial deliveries. On Saturdays and Sundays they are available for moves, which lets us offer all-inclusive prices.

What is included in the price?

The equipped truck, the moving crew, diesel and mileage, full insurance, moving blankets and floor protection. Boxes and packing service are available as options.

Do you move walk-up apartments?

Yes. Indicate the number of floors at both addresses in your request: it is factored into the time and price.

Do you do commercial moves?

Yes, offices and stores on weekends, so your business is not interrupted during the week.

Which areas do you cover?

The island of Montreal, Laval, the North Shore (Terrebonne, Boisbriand, Blainville…) and the South Shore (Longueuil, Brossard, Saint-Hubert…), plus long-distance moves within Quebec on request.
